---
title: "Blog"
description: "Photography notes and stories by Garry Sykes."  # TODO: rewrite
listing:
  contents: "posts/*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories, draft]  # draft: badge in preview only (drafts excluded from render)
  date-format: medium
  categories: true
  feed: true
---

```{=html}
<script>
  // `draft` in listing fields emits .listing-draft for any post with a draft key
  // ("true", or blank for draft: false). Only real drafts get .is-draft (pill + fade).
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post .listing-draft").forEach((el) => {
      if (el.textContent.trim() === "true") el.closest(".quarto-post").classList.add("is-draft");
      else el.remove();
    });
  });
</script>
```
